{{Tool

|COMPATIBILITY= [[:Category: Arma 3|Arma 3]]

|DOWNLOAD= {{Link|link= http://store.steampowered.com/app/233800/|text= Part of Arma 3 Tools package on Steam}}

|DESCRIPTION= {{Feature|warning|This tool has been replaced by [[Work Drive]] and is now deprecated.}}
mapFolder is a simple batch script that created symbolic link from and to Arma 3 Tools, Arma 3, Arma 3 GU* and P drive. This has been designed to increase productivity.<br>
Why a symbolic link rather than a shortcut? Simply because symbolic links are like mounts point, the link can be used in scripts, applications etc... whereas you can't with a shortcut.<br>
<br>
''*Copy of the game maintained by [[Game Updater]]''<br>
<br>
Hereafter, the diagram of links created (source and link)<br>
[[File:mapFolders_links.jpg|400px]]
|COMMAND= mapFolders.bat

|OPTIONS=
|EXAMPLE= mapFolders.bat
|NOTES= You must allow mapFolders in your settings from [[Arma 3: Tools Launcher]], "Preferences", "Settings" before running mapFolder.<br>Keep in mind the source directories doesn't move, they stay in their path.
